Jonas / Ben — see proposed approach from billing ops below. I've attached a simple schedule (payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx) with a split invoice layout and conditional release windows.

Summary proposal (high level):
- Invoice A: Nova Platform Europe BV (EU entity) — net amount = subscription portion; apply reverse-charge (0% VAT) when valid EU VAT cert is on file.
- Invoice B: Nova Platform UK Ltd (UK entity) — charge UK VAT if the UK entity is not registered for VAT as a non-established purchaser; otherwise apply reverse-charge if valid UK evidence is provided.
- Timing: Issue both invoices on 2026-08-10 but set settlement windows: 30 days for UK invoice, 45 days for EU invoice pending certificate revalidation.
- Conditional hold: If EU cert not validated by 2026-08-16 (one day after expiration) we will:
  * Move the EU invoice to "pending evidence" and hold 25% of the invoice value (refund/credit release upon validation).
  * Continue to accept payment for the UK invoice per normal cadence.

Items for Nova to provide: legal names, VAT numbers, and any supplier self-billing agreement if they want consolidated reporting.

Attachment: payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx (xlsx stub)

If that looks OK Jonas, I'll generate draft invoices and a short amendment to the SOW for signature (DocuSign).

Kimberly Park

1) Invoices & timing
- We will issue Invoice A (Nova Platform Europe BV) and Invoice B (Nova Platform UK Ltd) dated 2026-08-10.
- The EU invoice will show the tax line "reverse-charge (0% VAT) — pending validation". If we receive validated EU VAT evidence by 2026-08-18 we will mark the EU invoice as exempt and clear the conditional hold.
- If evidence is not validated by 2026-08-18, we will place a conditional hold only on the *exempt portion* equivalent to the tax liability estimate (we estimate ~25% of the exempt amount as a conservative hold). That hold will be applied to the EU-exempt portion, not the total payment.

2) UK treatment
- Based on the info you provided, the UK portion looks like it will be standard VAT unless you share evidence of non-established purchaser status or a UK VAT reversal mechanism. Please confirm the UK VAT registration number and we'll confirm taxability.

- I've requested billing ops to prepare an SOW amendment to capture the split-invoice flow and conditional hold terms. You'll receive a DocuSign link shortly: https://www.docusign.com/Amendment/NP-2026-094 (link).
